The Site is private. These resources require the same authorized access as the interface. An agent without an authenticated session can use a JSON file downloaded and provided by the owner. No separate public endpoint or MCP server is provided.

Stable links

The landing page is at /. The interactive atlas is at /atlas.html. Existing root links with atlas parameters redirect to the atlas. The interface stores its current selection in URL parameters. Direct links, reload, and browser Back/Forward restore that selection.

ParameterAccepted values
viewtree, papers, questions
branchA branch ID from the dataset, such as evolution.
paperA paper ID, such as dgm or hyperagents.
questionq1, q2, q3; omit for all.
qSearch text in the paper index, up to 240 characters.
collapsed, zoomOptional diagram preferences: 1 to collapse; zoom clamped to 0.75–1.5.
DGM · lineage and search ↗Hyperagents · improvement ability ↗

Invalid parameters fall back to valid defaults. An explicit valid branch determines paper membership; a paper outside it falls back to the branch's first paper. With no valid branch, a valid paper determines its own branch. In the index, the selected paper follows the current results when possible.

Operating the interface

  • Navigation and paper selections use real links. Modified clicks still open a new tab.
  • Branch links have stable IDs, for example branch-evolution, and data-node values.
  • Paper links use data-action="select-paper" and data-paper-id.
  • Research lenses use data-question and expose aria-pressed.
  • The harness toggle exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls.
  • The detail panel #inspector exposes the selected data-paper-id and data-branch-id.
  • Use Tab and Enter for native controls. Press / to focus search, and Escape to clear it.

Capability pathways

pathways.html renders all six routes without JavaScript. In JSON, read branches[id].pathway for stages, lecture numbers, proposed evaluations, method links, and reading roles. Resolve course_source_id through course_sources. A bridge reading supports part of a route and is not assigned to its later lectures. Branches with no verified readings have an empty paper array and no selected paper in the URL.

Proposed evaluations and improvement hypotheses are editorial research ideas, separate from paper evidence. Do not turn stage order into lineage edges. cross_cutting_facets apply across routes.

Interpretation rules

Branch parent_id expresses taxonomy; paper branch_ids express classification. Pathway stages are editorial capability targets, not chronology, prerequisites, paper ancestry, or agent-version lineage. Capability gains alone do not establish persistent self-improvement.

The question lenses include tested and mechanism only. They dim other branches and filter the index. The question matrix retains all papers. Excluded or unverified entries must not be interpreted as negative findings.

Tested tested
Tested within the specific experimental scope in the note; not a general proof.
Mechanism mechanism
The mechanism is present or provides indirect support; the research question is not fully isolated.
Unverified unknown
The atlas has not verified evidence for this question; not evidence of absence.
Out of scope outside
Outside the core method's stated scope.

Always preserve the scope note and source URL when using an evidence annotation.
